formats.name: feed_image
formats.notes: JPEG only, sRGB, width 320-1440 px (API). Alt text up to 1000 chars.

formats.name: carousel
formats.notes: API max 10 items; app limit reported as 20 (third-party headline). Counts as one post for the API cap.

formats.name: reel
formats.notes: API range 3 s to 15 min. App editor limit 3 min announced 2025-01-21 for US; other regions unverified. MOV or MP4, H.264/HEVC, 23-60 fps, max width 1920.

formats.name: trial_reel
formats.notes: Shown to non-followers first; graduation MANUAL or SS_PERFORMANCE.

formats.name: story_image
formats.notes: JPEG sRGB. 24 h life. API cannot add link, poll or location stickers.

formats.name: broadcast_channel_message
formats.notes: One-way from creator: text, photo, video, voice note, polls. No member cap stated.

formats.name: dm_media
formats.notes: Image 8 MB, audio/video/pdf 25 MB. Text max 1000 bytes. 24 h window.
